text:
Items: black coffee (~5 kcal), milk (about 150 ml, ~75 kcal), a muffin (~150 kcal), a bowl of flake cereal (~40 g, ~150 kcal), 3 slices of toasted bread (~200 kcal), Vegemite (~10 kcal), margarine (~35 kcal), peanut butter (~50 kcal), and a sugar packet (~25 kcal).

Served total: 5 + 75 + 150 + 150 + 200 + 10 + 35 + 50 + 25 = 700 kcal.

I assumed some leftovers, since people rarely finish everything (perhaps part of the muffin or a spread). I set leftover at about 60 kcal, so eaten is about 640 kcal.

Macros for the eaten portion:
- Protein: milk 5 g, cereal 3 g, bread 7 g, muffin 3 g, peanut butter 2 g, which comes to about 20 g.
- Fat: muffin 7 g, milk 3 g, margarine 4 g, peanut butter 4 g, bread 2 g, cereal 1 g, which comes to about 21 g.
- Carbohydrate: roughly 100 g (cereal 33, bread 35, muffin 20, milk 7, sugar 5).

{"served_kcal":700,"leftover_kcal":60,"kcal":640,"protein_g":20,"carbs_g":100,"fat_g":21}
